description: Feature registry - see CLAUDE.md's Feature Items section for authoring guidelines.

features.name: Action Surge
features.description: You can push yourself beyond your normal limits for a moment. On your turn, you gain 10 stamina immediately. Once you use this feature, you must finish an 8 hour rest before you can use it again.

features.name: Arcane Recovery
features.description: You have learned to regain some of your magical energy by studying your spellbook. Once per day during a short rest, you can recover mana equal to half your wizard level (rounded up).

features.name: Arcane Training
features.description: You can cast one cantrip of your choice from any spell list. Intelligence is your spellcasting ability for it.

features.name: Bardic Inspiration
features.description: You can inspire others through stirring words or music. Spend 1 mana to choose one creature other than yourself within 60 feet who can hear you. That creature gains one Bardic Inspiration die (d6). Once within the next 10 minutes, the creature can roll the die and add the number rolled to one ability check, attack roll, or saving throw.

features.name: Bio-Regeneration
features.description: Your modified biology allows rapid cellular regeneration. At the start of your turn, if you have at least 1 hit point, you regain hit points equal to your Constitution modifier (minimum 1). You can spend 3 stamina to double this regeneration for 1 minute.

features.name: Channel Divinity
features.description: You can channel divine energy directly from your deity to fuel magical effects. You start with two effects: Turn Undead and an effect determined by your domain. You regain uses after a short or long rest.

features.name: Chilling Presence
features.description: When you hit a creature with an attack, you can reduce its speed by 10 feet until the start of your next turn. You can use this trait a number of times equal to your proficiency bonus, and you regain all expended uses when you finish a long rest.

features.name: Craftsmen
features.description: You gain a +1 bonus to Craft skill checks.

features.name: Cunning Action
features.description: Your quick thinking and agility allow you to move and act quickly. Dash, Disengage, and Hide actions cost 1 less stamina (minimum 0).

features.name: Cybernetic Resilience
features.description: Your body is partially mechanical, making you resistant to biological threats. You have advantage on saving throws against disease, poison, and necrotic damage. Additionally, you can function without sleep and can survive in hostile environments (vacuum, extreme temperatures) for extended periods.

features.name: Divine Smite
features.description: When you hit a creature with a melee weapon attack, you can expend mana to deal radiant damage to the target, in addition to the weapon's damage. The extra damage is 2d8 for 2 mana, plus 1d8 for each additional mana spent, to a maximum of 5d8.

features.name: Divine Spellcasting
features.description: You can cast divine spells through your faith and devotion. Wisdom is your spellcasting ability for your cleric spells. You prepare spells through prayer and meditation.

features.name: Dream Walking
features.description: You can enter and manipulate the dreams of sleeping creatures. By meditating for 1 minute while within 100 feet of a sleeping creature, you can enter their dreamscape. There, you can extract information, plant suggestions, or create nightmares that deal psychic damage when they wake.

features.name: Dwarven Resilience
features.description: You have advantage on saving throws against poison, and you have resistance against poison damage.

features.name: Favored Enemy
features.description: You have significant experience studying, tracking, hunting, and even talking to certain types of enemies. You have advantage on skill checks to track your favored enemies and recall information about them.

features.name: Fey Ancestry
features.description: You have advantage on saving throws against being charmed or magically put to sleep.

features.name: Font of Magic
features.description: You tap into a deep wellspring of magic within yourself. You have a number of sorcery points equal to your sorcerer level. You can use sorcery points to create spell slots or convert spell slots into sorcery points. You regain all spent sorcery points when you finish a long rest.

features.name: Genetic Modification
features.description: You can alter biological structures at the genetic level. By spending 10 minutes and 5 stamina, you can grant yourself or an ally one mutation: claws (+1d6 damage), enhanced senses (darkvision 60ft), carapace (+2 AC), or gills (water breathing). The mutation lasts 8 hours.

features.name: ICE Breaker
features.description: You can create powerful hacking programs that shatter digital defenses. When hacking, you can spend 2 stamina to automatically succeed on one security bypass. You can also launch ICE attacks that deal psychic damage to targets connected to the same network.

features.name: Illusory Reality
features.description: Your illusions are so convincing they become partially real. When you cast an illusion spell or create an illusion, you can spend 3 mana to make one object from the illusion real for up to 1 minute. The object can't deal damage or directly harm creatures, but otherwise functions as a real object.

features.name: Jack In
features.description: You can interface directly with digital systems and networks. By touching any electronic device, you can access its data, bypass security, or take control. Make an Intelligence check contested by the system's security rating.

features.name: Jack of All Trades
features.description: You can add half your proficiency bonus (rounded down) to any ability check you make that doesn't already use your proficiency bonus. This represents your wide-ranging knowledge and experience.

features.name: Keen Mind
features.description: You always know which way is north, and you can accurately recall anything you have seen or heard within the past month.

features.name: Ki Points
features.description: Your training allows you to harness the mystic energy of ki. You have a number of ki points equal to your monk level. You can spend these points to fuel various ki features such as Flurry of Blows, Patient Defense, and Step of the Wind. You regain all spent ki points when you finish a short or long rest.

features.name: Lay on Hands
features.description: Your blessed touch can heal wounds. You have a pool of healing power that replenishes when you take a long rest. With that pool, you can restore a total number of hit points equal to your paladin level × 5. You can touch a creature and draw power from the pool to restore hit points to that creature.

features.name: Lightning Reflexes
features.description: Electricity courses through your body, enhancing your speed. Your base movement speed increases by 10 feet. When you move at least 20 feet in a straight line, you can make a melee attack that deals an additional 1d8 lightning damage. You also have resistance to lightning damage.

features.name: Martial Arts
features.description: Your practice of martial arts gives you mastery of combat styles that use unarmed strikes. You gain the following benefits while unarmed or wielding only monk weapons: You can use Dexterity instead of Strength for attack and damage rolls, your unarmed strikes deal 1d6 damage, and when you make an attack you can make an additional unarmed strike for 1 stamina.

features.name: Mask of the Wild
features.description: You can attempt to hide even when you are only lightly obscured by foliage, heavy rain, falling snow, mist, and other natural phenomena.

features.name: Mountain Born
features.description: You're acclimated to high altitude, including elevations above 20,000 feet. You're also naturally adapted to cold climates.

features.name: Natural Explorer
features.description: You are particularly familiar with one type of natural environment and are adept at traveling and surviving in such regions. In your favored terrain, you gain various benefits to navigation, tracking, and foraging.

features.name: Necromech Conversion
features.description: You can convert corpses into cybernetic undead servants. Spend 10 minutes and 5 mana to raise a corpse as a necromech minion with implanted weapons and armor plating. It obeys your mental commands and lasts until destroyed or you dismiss it. You can control up to your Intelligence modifier in necromechs.

features.name: Psionic Strike
features.description: You can infuse your weapons with psychic energy. When you hit with a melee attack, you can spend 2 mana to deal an additional 2d8 psychic damage. The target must also succeed on an Intelligence save or be stunned until the end of your next turn.

features.name: Quick Draw
features.description: Your reflexes are lightning-fast with firearms. You can draw and fire a ranged weapon seamlessly. Additionally, when rolling initiative you may immediately make one free attack before normal turn order begins, and you have advantage on attack rolls against creatures that haven't acted yet in combat.

features.name: Rage
features.description: In battle, you fight with primal ferocity. On your turn, you can spend 3 stamina to enter a rage. While raging, you gain bonus damage on melee attacks, resistance to physical damage, and advantage on Strength checks and saves. Your rage lasts for 1 minute.

features.name: Reality Warp
features.description: You can bend the laws of reality in a small area. By spending 4 mana, you can choose one: create difficult terrain, reverse gravity, or cause objects to phase through walls. The effect lasts for 1 minute in a 20-foot radius.

features.name: Reckless Attack
features.description: You can throw aside all concern for defense to attack with fierce desperation. When you make your first attack on your turn, you can decide to attack recklessly, giving you advantage on melee attack rolls using Strength during this turn, but attack rolls against you have advantage until your next turn.

features.name: Rune Inscription
features.description: You can inscribe magical runes onto objects and surfaces. Spend 1 minute and 3 mana to inscribe a rune with one effect: protection (+1 AC), sharpness (+1d6 damage), warding (detect creatures), or explosive (2d10 damage when triggered). You can maintain a number of active runes equal to your Intelligence modifier.

features.name: Runic Empowerment
features.description: You can empower yourself with temporary runic tattoos. During a short rest, inscribe up to 3 runes on your body. Each rune grants a benefit: Strength rune (+2 Strength), Speed rune (+15ft movement), Resilience rune (resistance to one damage type). Runes last until your next long rest.

features.name: Second Wind
features.description: You can spend 2 stamina to regain hit points equal to 1d10 + your fighter level. Once you use this feature, you must finish a short or long rest before you can use it again.

features.name: Shadow Step
features.description: You can spend 2 stamina to teleport up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space you can see that is in dim light or darkness. You can use this trait a number of times equal to your proficiency bonus, and you regain all expended uses when you finish a long rest.

features.name: Shadow Touched
features.description: You have advantage on Stealth checks in dim light or darkness.

features.name: Sneak Attack
features.description: You know how to strike subtly and exploit a foe's distraction. Once per turn, you can deal an extra 1d6 damage to one creature you hit with an attack if you have advantage on the attack roll. The damage increases as you gain rogue levels.

features.name: Sorcerous Origin
features.description: Your innate magic comes from a sorcerous origin that imbues you with power. Choose an origin such as Draconic Bloodline or Wild Magic, which grants you features and abilities tied to the source of your power.

features.name: Spellcasting
features.description: You have learned to cast spells through study and practice. Intelligence is your spellcasting ability for your wizard spells. You can cast wizard spells from your spellbook.

features.name: Stone Endurance
features.description: As a reaction when you take damage, you can spend 2 stamina to reduce that damage by 1d10 + your CON modifier. You can use this trait a number of times equal to your proficiency bonus, and you regain all expended uses when you finish a long rest.

features.name: Stonecunning
features.description: Whenever you make an Intelligence (History) check related to the origin of stonework, you are considered proficient in the History skill and add double your proficiency bonus to the check.

features.name: Storm Surge
features.description: You can summon devastating storms. Spend 4 mana to create a storm in a 30-foot radius for 1 minute. You can command the storm to strike targets with lightning (3d10 damage), create strong winds (difficult terrain), or summon rain that extinguishes fires and obscures vision.

features.name: Sure-Footed
features.description: You have advantage on ability checks and saving throws to avoid being knocked prone or shoved.

features.name: Telekinetic Shield
features.description: You maintain a shield of mental force around yourself. As a reaction when you are hit by an attack, you can spend 1 mana to add your Intelligence modifier to your AC. You can also use this to push attackers back 10 feet or deflect projectiles.

features.name: Temporal Shift
features.description: You can manipulate the flow of time around yourself. Once per short rest, you can rewind time by 6 seconds (1 round), undoing your actions and returning to your previous position with full knowledge of what occurred. Costs 5 mana.

features.name: Time Dilation
features.description: You perceive time differently than others. You can spend 3 mana to gain advantage on initiative rolls and +10 to your movement speed for 1 minute. At higher levels, you can slow enemies caught in a 15-foot radius.

features.name: Trance
features.description: You don't need to sleep. Instead, you meditate deeply for 4 hours a day. After resting in this way, you gain the same benefit that a human does from 8 hours of sleep.

features.name: Trick Shot
features.description: You can pull off impossible shots with firearms. By spending 2 stamina, you can: ricochet a shot around corners, disarm a target, shoot objects out of the air, or shoot through cover without penalty. These shots ignore half and three-quarters cover.

features.name: Void Gaze
features.description: Your eyes have seen beyond reality. You can peer into the void to see invisible creatures, detect lies, and sense magic. Creatures that meet your gaze must succeed on a Wisdom save or become frightened for 1 minute. You have advantage on saves against illusions and charm effects.

features.name: Amorphous Resilience
features.description: Your semisolid body has no vital organs to target and can flow through cracks a rigid frame never could. You have advantage on saving throws against being restrained or squeezed into a smaller space, and critical hits against you deal only normal damage.

features.name: Caustic Secretion
features.description: Your body weeps a mild acid when threatened. As a reaction when a creature hits you with a melee attack, you can spend 1 stamina to deal 1d4 acid damage to it. You have resistance to acid damage.

features.name: Deathless Vigor
features.description: You have already died once, and your body no longer negotiates with exhaustion the way living flesh does. You don't need to eat, drink, or breathe, and you have advantage on saving throws against poison and disease. When you would be reduced to 0 hit points but not killed outright, you can spend 2 stamina to instead drop to 1 hit point.

features.name: Graveborn Chill
features.description: The cold of the grave clings to you and unsettles the living. Creatures within 5 feet of you that can see you have disadvantage on saving throws against being frightened, and you have resistance to cold damage.

features.name: Elemental Attunement
features.description: When you take this trait, choose one damage type: acid, cold, fire, lightning, or thunder. You have resistance to that damage type, and once per long rest you can infuse a weapon attack with it, adding 1d4 damage of the chosen type to the hit.

features.name: Volatile Surge
features.description: When you are reduced to a quarter of your maximum hit points or fewer, elemental energy floods out of you. You can spend 3 mana to unleash a burst that deals 2d6 damage of your Elemental Attunement's type to each creature within 10 feet of you (allies included - choose your moment carefully). Usable once per long rest.

features.name: Fanatical Devotion
features.description: Years of ritual conviction have hardened your will past the point of easy breaking. You have advantage on saving throws against being frightened or charmed, and once per long rest you can reroll a failed Channel check.

features.name: Whispered Communion
features.description: You have learned to listen for the voice your order serves, even when no ritual is underway. Once per long rest, you can spend 10 minutes in quiet communion to ask a single yes-or-no question and sense whether the answer is true - though the source of the answer is not always trustworthy.

features.name: Predator's Instinct
features.description: You've learned to read a hunt the way a wolf pack does - who's wounded, who's about to bolt, where the exit is. You have advantage on Perception checks to track creatures, and you can't be surprised while at least one hostile creature is within 30 feet of you.

features.name: Thick Hide
features.description: Years spent in the company of tooth and claw have toughened your skin. You gain a +1 bonus to your effective damage reduction from any armor you have equipped, and you take no damage reduction penalty while unarmored.

features.name: Alien Mind
features.description: Your thoughts don't run along paths a mortal mind can easily unravel. You have advantage on saving throws against being frightened, charmed, or having your thoughts read, and creatures attempting to telepathically contact you sense only unsettling static unless you allow otherwise.

features.name: Otherworldly Resilience
features.description: Something not quite of this reality steadies you against harm that should not exist. You have resistance to psychic damage, and once per long rest you can spend 2 mana to gain advantage on a single saving throw.

features.name: Warren Tactics
features.description: You grew up fighting in packs against things much bigger than you. When you attack a creature that is within 5 feet of at least one of your allies, you gain a +1 bonus to the attack roll.

features.name: Scavenger's Instinct
features.description: A lifetime of picking warrens clean has sharpened your eye for what's worth taking. You have advantage on checks to find hidden objects, traps, or valuables, and once per long rest you can reroll a failed Thievery check.

features.name: Full Load, No Stops
features.description: When you move at least 20 feet in a straight line without stopping this turn, you can spend 2 stamina to barrel through the first creature in your path instead of going around it. That creature takes 1d8 bludgeoning damage and is shoved along with you to the space you end your movement in, unless it succeeds on a Strength save or is anchored (braced, restrained, or larger than you).

features.name: Road-Worn
features.description: Years behind the wheel have taught your body to keep going long after most would quit. You have advantage on saving throws against exhaustion, and difficult terrain doesn't cost you extra movement while you're moving in a straight line.

features.name: Into the Blaze
features.description: You've walked into more burning buildings than you can count. You have resistance to fire damage, and you can move through fire, smoke, and other hazardous terrain without penalty or harm from the terrain itself.

features.name: Rescue Carry
features.description: You can sling a creature over your shoulder without breaking stride. As part of your movement, you can pick up one willing or incapacitated creature of your size or smaller and carry it with you at no penalty to your speed. While you're carrying a creature this way, you can spend 2 stamina to intercept an attack that would hit it, redirecting the attack to yourself instead.

features.name: Precision Incision
features.description: You know exactly where to cut. When you hit a creature with a Pierce attack, you can spend 1 stamina to strike a vital point: the attack ignores half of the target's damage reduction, and you gain advantage on your next Medicine check made regarding that creature.

features.name: Golden Hour
features.description: You work fastest when it matters most. As an action, you can spend 3 mana to stabilize and heal a creature at half its maximum hit points or lower, restoring hit points equal to 2d8 + your Intelligence modifier. You can only use this feature once per short or long rest - the golden hour doesn't open twice.

features.name: Audit
features.description: As an action, spend 1 mana to scrutinize one creature you can see within 30 feet, examining it for exploitable flaws the way you'd examine a ledger for errors. Until the end of your next turn, the first attack or spell you make against that creature has advantage, and any resistance it has to the damage type dealt is ignored.

features.name: Compound Interest
features.description: Damage you deal to a creature you've Audited this encounter doesn't cost it just once. Each time you damage that creature, it accrues debt equal to a quarter of the damage dealt (rounded down). At the start of its turn, it takes damage equal to its accrued debt, then the debt resets to 0 - the price of falling behind on payments.

features.name: On the House
features.description: You know exactly what everyone's drinking. During a short rest, you can spend 2 stamina to pour drinks for up to 3 creatures who aren't hostile to you. Each one chooses to regain stamina equal to 1d6 + your Charisma modifier, or gain advantage on their next saving throw made within the next hour.

features.name: Read the Room
features.description: You've spent years watching a room for the exact moment things are about to go sideways. You have advantage on Perception checks made to sense the mood or intentions of a crowd. Once per long rest, you can spend 1 minute working a hostile crowd to defuse it, making a Diplomacy check to avert violence before the first blow is struck.

features.name: Get the Scoop
features.description: Given 10 minutes to ask around, dig through records, or talk to the right people, you can learn one true and useful fact about a creature, location, or organization - a weakness, a secret, a routine - as determined by your GM. You have advantage on the first attack roll, skill check, or saving throw you make that turns that fact to your advantage.

features.name: Breaking News
features.description: When you publicly expose a secret or call out an enemy's weakness where your allies can hear you, word travels fast. Each ally who heard you gains advantage on their next attack roll against that target, made before the end of your next turn.

features.name: Clear for Departure
features.description: As an action, you can spend 2 mana to give one ally within 60 feet who can hear you clearance to move. That ally can immediately use their reaction to move up to their speed without provoking opportunity attacks, or to make one weapon attack.

features.name: Eye in the Tower
features.description: You track the whole battlefield the way a controller tracks every plane in the sky. You always know the position of every ally and enemy within 120 feet of you, even ones you can't directly see, and neither you nor any ally within that range can be surprised while you're conscious.

features.name: Strike the Vein
features.description: You know how to find the weak seam in anything, be it rock or flesh. When you spend a full turn attacking the same creature or object without moving, your next Blunt attack against it that turn scores a critical hit on a roll of 18-20 instead of only 20.

features.name: Tunnel Vision
features.description: You can dig through earth, loose rock, and similar terrain at a rate of 5 feet per minute using only your tools, and you have darkvision out to 60 feet. While underground or in an enclosed space, you have advantage on saving throws against being frightened - the walls have never scared you.

features.name: Battle Rations
features.description: Given 10 minutes and a fire during a short rest, you can cook a meal for up to 4 creatures. Each creature who eats gains temporary hit points equal to 1d8 + your Wisdom modifier, lasting until their next long rest or until depleted.

features.name: Knife Work
features.description: Your hands never slow down at the cutting board, and they don't slow down anywhere else either. When you make a Pierce attack with a small blade (dagger, knife, or similar), you can spend 1 stamina to make one additional attack with that weapon as part of the same action.

features.name: Claim Denied
features.description: As a reaction when a creature within 5 feet of you is hit by an attack, you can spend 2 stamina to intervene. Reduce the damage that creature takes by an amount equal to 1d10 + your Constitution modifier - the rest, if any, still applies. You've found a technicality, and it's not in the attacker's favor.

features.name: Risk Assessment
features.description: You've read enough policies to know exactly how disasters usually start. You and allies within 30 feet of you have advantage on the first saving throw each of you makes against a trap, ambush, or other surprise effect in a given encounter.

features.name: One More Take
features.description: Once per short or long rest, immediately after you make an attack roll, ability check, or saving throw, you can throw a fit and demand a retake: reroll and use the new result, even if it's worse.

features.name: Precocious Talent
features.description: You've been performing since before you could read a script. You have advantage on Deception and Diplomacy checks against creatures who underestimate you for your age or size, and once per short rest you can substitute your Charisma modifier for any other ability modifier on one skill check.

features.name: Main Character Energy
features.description: While at least one creature can see you, you have advantage on Diplomacy, Deception, and Intimidation checks. While no creature can see you, you have disadvantage on the same checks - you just don't perform the same without an audience.

features.name: Viral Moment
features.description: Once per long rest, spend 3 mana to attempt something spectacular: make one attack roll, skill check, or saving throw with advantage. If you succeed, each ally within 30 feet who witnessed it gains 1d6 temporary stamina, hyped up by what they just saw.

features.name: Commander in Chief
features.description: Once per long rest, as an action, rally your allies with a single address: each ally within 30 feet who can hear you gains advantage on their next attack roll or saving throw made before the end of your next turn, plus temporary hit points equal to 1d8 + your Charisma modifier.

features.name: Secret Service
features.description: You're never truly alone. As a reaction when you would take damage, you can spend 3 mana to have an unseen protector intercept the blow instead - you take no damage. Usable once per short rest.

features.name: Transformation Sequence
features.description: As a bonus action, spend 1 stamina to transform: your next attack this turn deals an extra 1d8 damage. Unless an ally is within 5 feet of you when you transform, one enemy that can see you gets a free attack against you before your pose finishes.

features.name: Team Up
features.description: While you and at least one ally are both engaged with (adjacent to or attacking) the same enemy, you gain a +1 bonus to attack rolls against that enemy for each other ally engaged with it, to a maximum of +3.

features.name: Summon
features.description: As an action, spend 3 mana to summon a spectral monster into an unoccupied space within 30 feet. It has hit points equal to twice your class level and can make one Slash or Cast attack dealing 1d8 + your Intelligence modifier on each of your turns. You can have only one monster summoned at a time, and it vanishes if reduced to 0 hit points or if you dismiss it.

features.name: Draw!
features.description: Once per short rest, draw on fate itself: roll a d6. On a 1-3, you gain advantage on your next attack roll or skill check. On a 4-6, you regain 1d4 mana.

features.name: Well, Actually
features.description: When a creature you can see succeeds on an attack roll, skill check, or saving throw, you can spend 1 stamina to interject with an unsolicited correction: make a Lore check contested by that creature's relevant ability check. If you win, it must reroll and use the new result.

features.name: Karma Farming
features.description: Whenever you land a hit, deceive, or intimidate a creature in front of at least one ally, you gain 1 point of Karma (maximum 5). As a reaction, you can spend all your accumulated Karma to grant yourself advantage on one roll - the validation carries you through.

features.name: Glimpse the Threads
features.description: Once per short rest, as a reaction before you or an ally within 30 feet makes an attack roll, ability check, or saving throw, you can grant advantage on that roll - you saw this moment coming.

features.name: Cryptic Prophecy
features.description: As an action, spend 2 mana to speak a prophecy over a creature within 60 feet. Once before the end of the encounter, the next time that creature would be reduced to 0 hit points, it drops to 1 hit point instead - fate isn't ready to let go of it yet.

features.name: Confessional
features.description: Once per short rest, spend 1 minute speaking your true thoughts aloud to an unseen camera. Doing so, you can reroll any one failed check you made in the last minute and take the better result - venting clears your head.

features.name: Showmance
features.description: At the start of an encounter, choose one ally as your alliance. While that ally is within 30 feet of you, you both have advantage on Diplomacy and Deception checks made to influence a third party. You can change your alliance at the start of any of your turns.

features.name: Rally the Crew
features.description: Once per short rest, as an action, shout a rousing command: each ally within 30 feet gains temporary hit points equal to 1d8 + your Charisma modifier and can immediately move up to half their speed without using their action.

features.name: Plunder
features.description: When you defeat a creature or search a body, you have advantage on the check to find anything valuable on it. Once per long rest, you find a small, useful item of your GM's choosing - you always seem to come away with exactly what you needed.

features.name: Trade Places
features.description: As a reaction when you would be hit by an attack, spend 2 mana to swap places with an illusory duplicate: the attack automatically misses, and you teleport up to 15 feet to an unoccupied space you can see.

features.name: Mischief Woven
features.description: Once per long rest, target one creature within 30 feet and make a Deception check contested by its Wisdom saving throw. On a success, the creature is convinced of one false, harmless fact about its immediate surroundings for 1 minute - a wall that isn't there, a door that is, an ally who's secretly you.
